cards.answer: Twitch is a marksman and assassin who approaches in camouflage and gains attack speed when he emerges. He stacks poison with attacks, then uses Contaminate for stronger damage against poisoned enemies. His kit supports AD and AP damage scaling, with true damage from poison and piercing ranged attacks during his ultimate.
cards.counterplay: Respect unexpected approaches and avoid lining up with allies during his ultimate.

cards.answer: Ambush grants camouflage after a delay and bonus movement speed, followed by bonus attack speed when camouflage ends. Attacking or casting Venom Cask or Contaminate ends the camouflage. An enemy champion dying with Deadly Venom resets Ambush's cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Respect surprise approaches and renewed ambushes after poisoned allies die.
